name: Product Name Two Lines Max

features.text: optional bold lead-in, then // and the benefit in sentence case.
five to seven features; nine lines of text at most.
Or a plain feature with no lead-in. Pick one style per sheet.
Cite the test behind any number (based on ASTM D0000 test results).
End every feature with a period.

description: One paragraph, about 80 words. Say what the product is, what it does and where it is used. Name the product in full once (MOC® Product Name). Keep claims to what the specifications and test results below support. No em dashes; use a comma, colon or period instead. Longer copy fits only when the features are short, and the build stops any sheet that runs over.
application: One or two sentences: how much, where it goes and how often.
